sn35.160:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Jīvakambavane || || Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū amantesi Bhikkhavoti || la || || Samādhim bhikkhave bhāvetha || samāhitassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || Kiñca yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || Cakkhum aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Rupā aniccāti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhuviññāṇam aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Cakkhusamphasso aniccoti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || Yam pidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitam || pe || tam pi Aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || Sotaṃ || Ghānaṃ || Jivhā || Kāyo || || Mano aniccoti yathābhutam okkhāyati || Dhammā aniccāti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || la || Yam pidam mano samphassapaccayā uppajjati sukkhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā || tam pi Aniccanti yathābhūtam okkhāyati || || Samādhim bhikkhave bhāvetha || samāhitassa bhikkhuno yathābhūtam okkhāyatīti || ||
